faq.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. The change takes effect immediately.
No. The free plan is permanent — no trial period, no credit card required. You get 5 posts a month, forever.

faq.q: Which AI is used to generate posts?
faq.a: LinkedInForge is powered by Google's Gemini, one of the most advanced language models on the market.

faq.q: Are 'Soon' features included in the price?
faq.a: Yes. Every feature listed as 'Soon' will be included in your plan at no extra cost as soon as it ships.

landing.badge: AI Content Studio for LinkedIn and Social Networks
landing.heroTitle: Transform your content into ready-to-publish posts.
landing.heroSubtitle: LinkedInForge is an AI LinkedIn post generator that transforms your videos, URLs, and ideas into content tailored to your style.
landing.heroDescription: Analyze a video, provide an URL, or start from an idea. LinkedInForge understands your content, adopts your tone with the Ghostwriter, and generates a post you can edit, validate, and publish.
landing.freeReassurance: 5 free generations · No credit card required
landing.slogan: Transform your content. Forge your presence.
landing.subSlogan: Videos, URLs, ideas: LinkedInForge transforms them into ready-to-publish content, in your style.

transformation.title: A video. An URL. An idea. Your content is ready.
transformation.subtitle: LinkedInForge doesn't just rephrase words. It analyzes your content to identify topics, key facts, and strong arguments. Then it adapts the result to your personal voice.

pillars.title: 🎥 Turn your videos into posts
pillars.body: Drop a video and let the AI analyze speech and visuals to extract key ideas and messages. Create LinkedIn posts grounded in what's actually inside your video.

pillars.title: 🌐 Turn any URL into content
pillars.body: Paste the link to your product, site, article, or landing page. LinkedInForge captures the Hero section and extracts your core value proposition.

pillars.title: ✍️ Write in your own authentic style
pillars.body: The Ghostwriter learns your communication style from your past posts and examples. Your vocabulary, pacing, and arguments serve as the foundation.

workflow.title: From raw content to a ready-to-share post
workflow.subtitle: A transparent workflow designed to save you hours while keeping total creative control.

steps.title: 01 — Provide your content
steps.body: Video, URL, or idea: start with what you already have on hand.

steps.title: 02 — LinkedInForge analyzes it
steps.body: Multimodal AI extracts facts, key insights, and actionable angles.

steps.title: 03 — Your Ghostwriter steps in
steps.body: Content is crafted according to your personal tone, goals, and platform best practices.

steps.title: 04 — You stay in control
steps.body: Preview, edit, copy, or schedule your publication with full peace of mind.

omnichannel.title: One source of content powers multiple channels
omnichannel.body: LinkedInForge is designed so you never have to rewrite the same message twice. Repurpose one core piece of content across multiple social platforms.
omnichannel.videoNote: With the Video Autopilot, your video footage becomes instantly actionable for your entire editorial calendar.

whyUs.title: Why LinkedInForge?
whyUs.subtitle: An approach rooted in understanding your real content rather than relying on generic prompts.

reasons.title: Understand before writing
reasons.body: The AI never starts from a vague prompt. It works directly from your real, grounded content.

reasons.title: Your voice over templates
reasons.body: The Ghostwriter adapts copy to your natural, authentic way of speaking.

reasons.title: Real substance, not generic fluff
reasons.body: Video, landing page, launch, product, or experience: start from what you actually have to share.

reasons.title: You stay in full control
reasons.body: LinkedInForge prepares the post. You review, edit, and decide when and where to publish.

rawMaterial.title: The content you already have is raw gold.
rawMaterial.body: You don't need to reinvent ten new ideas every week. You already have videos, blog articles, product pages, launches, and customer stories.
rawMaterial.action: LinkedInForge helps you transform that existing material into high-performing social content.
rawMaterial.cta: Start with your next piece of content
